Method of Attack: Running an automated script that searches for open printer ports and sends rogue print jobs to target devices
Exploiting remote code execution vulnerability to inject PostScript and invoke rogue jobs on Dell Xeon printers
Impacted Systems: High-end multi-functional printers at corporate headquarters
Receipt printers in small town restaurants
Printer brands including Afico, Brother, Canon, Epson, HP, Lexmark, Konica Minolta, Oki, Samsung
Indicators of Compromise: Printers spewing out messages with ASCII art and text referencing 'stackoverflowin the hacker god', 'flaming botnet', 'putin's forehead', and 'BTI's (break the internet) complex infrastructure'
